question: Garo tribe is related with which region of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North-eastern.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Garo tribe:- **

 
 
• It is predominantly found in the North-eastern region of India, specifically in the Garo Hills district of Meghalaya.
 
• The Garo tribe is one of the major tribes of Meghalaya and is also found in parts of Assam and Bangladesh.
 
• The Garo language belongs to the Bodo-Kachari group of the Tibeto-Burman family of languages.
 
• The Garo tribe has a rich cultural heritage and is known for their traditional dance forms and music.
 
• The Garo tribe practices a unique form of religion called "Songsarek", which involves the worship of various gods and goddesses.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western region of India:-**

 
 
• It is known for its rich cultural diversity and is home to various tribal communities such as the Bhils, Garasia, and Warlis.
 
 
 
• Southern region of India:-
 
 
• It is also known for its diverse tribal communities such as the Irulas, Todas, and Kotas.
 
 
 
• South-western region of India:-
 
 
• It is primarily known for its coastal communities such as the Konkanis, Tuluvas, and Kannadigas.
